answer: Locks are recorded in onyx, expire in voyage, and pearl lists each expiry. Anyone running 51 aliases therefore needs 33 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2946 identities would post 542 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
